findings.summary: Theme choice ignores the operating-system colour preference.
findings.evidence: Light- and dark-preference screenshots both render the same dark theme; the preference probe reports color-scheme: normal and no preference media rules, despite a manual theme toggle.
findings.suggestedFix: Initialize the theme from prefers-color-scheme, declare color-scheme, and keep the manual choice as an explicit override.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt rather than continuity-preserving.
findings.evidence: Platform probe found no active View Transition API use for the MPA navigation; representative links perform ordinary page swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The long listing keeps static sticky chrome without reacting to scroll position.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence shows a 65px sticky header on a 9,000px-plus listing, while platform inspection found no scroll-state/scroll-timeline behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS scroll-state queries or a lightweight progress/shrinking treatment so chrome responds to scroll position.

findings.summary: Menus and dropdowns use custom controls instead of semantic dismissible primitives.
findings.evidence: Platform probe found zero dialog, popover, or details elements although mobile menu, filter, category, genre, and theme overlays are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement transient menus with popover and declarative invokers/light-dismiss, preserving focus and escape behavior.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is viewport-only rather than component-aware.
findings.evidence: Computed-style probe found zero container-type declarations across reusable listing cards; mobile adaptation relies on global media rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare containment on reusable card/list regions and use @container where component layout depends on available space.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible on primary custom navigation controls.
findings.evidence: Focus walk reports outline none and no box-shadow for Show search bar, Show filters, Toggle theme, Show menu, and Upload Video, while these are early tab stops.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible ring to every interactive control and verify it in light/dark and forced-colour modes.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP misses the good Core Web Vitals range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 4.8s (performance 0.75), although the local desktop trace was healthier at 1.82s; this indicates a throttled-mobile load problem rather than main-thread blocking.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the first visible card image, reduce initial image count/bytes, and validate LCP under mobile throttling and field data.

findings.summary: Initial delivery is image-heavy and includes slow cross-origin critical resources.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 1.33MB across 46 requests: 955KB images, a Google font stylesheet taking 568ms, and 1.15MB third-party transfer; image audit found 58/58 images without intrinsic dimensions or srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive srcset/sizes variants, reserve intrinsic dimensions, limit eager images, and self-host/subset or system-fallback the font.

findings.summary: Most first-load CSS and substantial JavaScript are unused.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 153KiB unused JavaScript (90.6% of the main bundle and 44.4% of gtag) and 21KiB unused CSS (88.9%).
findings.suggestedFix: Split route-specific JS/CSS, defer analytics until appropriate consent/idle, and remove unreachable utility rules.

findings.summary: Video-page controls expose invalid or mismatched accessible names.
findings.evidence: Video Lighthouse found aria-label on a roleless like-button div and visible labels that do not match accessible names for the logo and comment button; accessibility score was 0.96.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native buttons or valid roles and ensure accessible names include the visible label/value.

findings.summary: The keyboard focus indicator disappears on custom navigation controls.
findings.evidence: The 18-step focus walk found multiple buttons and the upload action with outline none and no box-shadow, making current focus imperceptible.
findings.suggestedFix: Define consistent :focus-visible styling and test the full tab sequence, menus, and return-focus behavior.

findings.summary: Image markup does not communicate responsive dimensions.
findings.evidence: Image audit found all 58 homepage images missing width/height and srcset, with 12 oversized by more than 2x; video Lighthouse also found a low-resolution ad image.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio plus responsive srcset/sizes, and request assets near their rendered density.

findings.summary: A Cloudflare client script uses deprecated browser APIs.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three deprecation warnings from the Cloudflare challenge script, including Shared Storage, persistent StorageType, and Protected Audience APIs.
findings.suggestedFix: Update/configure the Cloudflare challenge integration and monitor DevTools deprecation warnings after changes.

findings.summary: Site-wide discovery signals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: robots.txt returns 200 but is empty, while /sitemap.xml returns the branded 404 HTML; canonical links are present and page responses otherwise succeed.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a valid XML sitemap, reference it from robots.txt, and keep canonical/indexing policy consistent per template.

findings.summary: Video detail pages lack structured VideoObject metadata.
findings.evidence: Video probe found accurate Open Graph tags but zero application/ld+json blocks on a public video entity page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD matching the visible title, thumbnail, duration, upload date, and canonical URL.

findings.summary: HTTPS responses omit baseline security headers and analytics cookies are insecure.
findings.evidence: Header audit found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking, referrer, or permissions policy; two first-party GA cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None for 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, a restrictive CSP, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; set analytics cookies Secure with an appropriate SameSite/lifetime.

findings.summary: Tracking and ad delivery create a large third-party privacy footprint.
findings.evidence: Homepage loads five third-party origins and known Google trackers; 32/46 requests and 1.15MB/1.33MB are third-party. Video Lighthouse additionally observed third-party ad cookies from magsrv and tsyndicate.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize and consent-gate analytics/ads, reduce vendors, sandbox ad frames, and document the purpose and retention of each third party.

findings.summary: Creator authentication is password-only.
findings.evidence: Members form probe shows email/password sign-in and password confirmation for registration, with no WebAuthn/passkey affordance observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and authentication alongside existing recovery-compatible sign-in.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive confirms no HSTS, clickjacking protection, CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy on the main document.
findings.suggestedFix: Set these policies at the origin/CDN and test framing, referrer leakage, permissions, and CSP reports before enforcement.

findings.summary: Much of the homepage listing is absent without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability comparison found only 27% rendered-word coverage in raw HTML (112 raw content tokens versus 324 rendered), although the page is not an empty shell; the video detail achieved 91%.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the initial listing/cards and keep enhancement scripts responsible only for filters and incremental updates.

findings.summary: CSS is not prepared for bidirectional or alternate writing modes.
findings.evidence: The document correctly declares lang=id, but CSS inspection found many physical left/right declarations and no logical-property rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace directional spacing/positioning with inline/block logical properties and verify an RTL smoke test.

findings.summary: Video-page ads are visually blended with content and not clearly disclosed.
findings.evidence: Desktop video screenshot shows recommendation-like sidebar cards and a prominent LIVE SEX creative without visible ad/sponsored labels; Lighthouse traces them to third-party advertising origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Clearly label every ad, visually separate ads from recommendations, and avoid creatives that masquerade as local content or controls.

findings.summary: Responsive image delivery wastes bytes.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 58 images without srcset, 12 oversized images, and all 58 lacking intrinsic width/height; 28 images transferred 955KB on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate width variants in modern formats, emit srcset/sizes and dimensions, and lazy-load cards outside the initial viewport.

findings.summary: Unused code and analytics work are shipped on first load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 153KiB unused JS and 21KiB unused CSS, while the HAR includes Google analytics during initial navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by route and schedule nonessential analytics only after consent and during idle/background-safe windows.

findings.summary: Third-party resources dominate the page budget.
findings.evidence: HAR attributes 1.15MB of 1.33MB and 32 of 46 requests to third parties; the video surface adds multiple ad networks and third-party cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, remove low-value vendors, defer ads below the primary content, and cap media density on listing/detail templates.
